title: SF278 (2025-2026 Regular): Noncitizen permit to carry applicants background check information scope expansion provision

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-01-16; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/SF/278/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced bill (2025-01-16); the bill only adds clause (7) to the application and the IAQ sentence to the sheriff's investigation. Strikes only the word 'and' and a period in clauses (5)-(6) (punctuation). Version read is the introduced bill as filed; no later version was read.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): (7) if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the applicant's country of birth and alien number or alien admission number.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 4): In addition, if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the sheriff must ensure that an Immigration Alien Query (IAQ) check is performed on the applicant.
